The '''CorSec Maximum Security Prison''' was a high-security prison located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and run by the [[Corellian Security Force]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], it was a stronghold of resistance.<ref name="TOR:PB" />
